literal: Incompatibility without food having-refused if-eats, harm is-not to-life.
translation: If one eats food that agrees with the body and deliberately refuses excess, there will be no harm to one's life.
modern: உடலுக்கு ஒவ்வாத உணவுகளைத் தவிர்த்து, அளவோடு உண்டால், உயிருக்கு எந்த நோயும் வராது.
explanation: This couplet explains the dietary basis of good health. The phrase 'மாறுபாடு இல்லாத உண்டி' refers to food that does not conflict with one's bodily constitution or the seasons. 'மறுத்து உண்ணின்' means eating with restraint, deliberately refusing excess even when the food is agreeable. When a person follows these two rules—eating compatible food and practicing moderation—their life will be free from 'ஊறுபாடு' (harm or disease).
